summary: NANO Nuclear's KRONOS MMR™ is a 15MWe microreactor small enough to deploy at a data center, remote military base, or university campus. On June 23, 2026, the NRC initiated formal review activities with University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign — the first step in a regulatory path that ends in a construction permit. SMCI signed a MOU to explore co-packaged nuclear power solutions for data centers. Roth Capital has a $45 target (128% upside from $19.76). Moon case: NRC approval + 1 hyperscaler deployment contract = $60+ (203%+).
